narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video utilizes a high-energy, parody-style 'action movie' trailer format to build suspense and mock-urgency. The chaotic sequences of running and shouting serve as a 'hook' to engage the audience before revealing the true intent: a celebratory announcement that the 'The DoDo Men' YouTube channel has reached 1.5 million subscribers.
